The Shape-Shifter Strikes'' |author=[[Ryder Windham]] |cover artist= |illustrator= |editor= |publisher=[[Scholastic]] |early release= |release date=[[February]] [[2003]]''[[Star Wars Adventures 5: The Shape-Shifter Strikes]]'' was released in a bundle with [[Star Wars Adventures Magazine 5|''Star Wars Adventure Magazine'' 5]], which was released in [[February]] [[2003]] |intl release= |rereleased= |media type=Paperback |pages=82 |isbn=0439458846 |isbn2= |isbn3= |audiobook=N/A |timeline=[[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]]{{CSWECite|I|151|Cradossk}} dates the events of the [[Star Wars Adventures (Scholastic)|''Star Wars Adventures'']] series to a year before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. |series=[[Star Wars Adventures (Scholastic)|''Star Wars Adventures'' (Scholastic)]] |preceded by=''[[Star Wars Adventures 4: Jango Fett vs. the Razor Eaters|Jango Fett vs. the Razor Eaters]]'' |followed by=''[[Star Wars Adventures 6: The Warlords of Balmorra|Warlords of Balmorra]]'' }} '''''Star Wars Adventures 5: The Shape-Shifter Strikes''''' was the fifth installment of [[Scholastic]]'s [[Star Wars Adventures (Scholastic)|''Star Wars Adventures'']] series.
